metrics.notes: Use suited height for all clearances
Steeper slides; 50° test ramp in the gym
Scales with gravity: 5.5 m on the Moon
Above 2.0 m needs ladders, stairs or a jetpack
Crawl ducts are 1.2 m square (crawl, not prone)
Authored interiors leave room for pipes and light
Top exit needs a 1.2 m landing
Player-built blocks fit flush against authored spaces
Sets the size of combat spaces
Clear line of sight in Screamer spaces
Capital ships stay in orbit or dock
Every district has one primary landmark

levels.name: Earth (starter planet)
levels.summary: The gameplay-scale Earth: a 120 km voxel planet, the largest size in the game. Kestrel Valley is its hand-authored starting region; the rest of the globe is procedural 'Earth Returns' territory (desert, forest, coast, tundra and the ruins of cities) that the Bloom spreads across as the story advances.
goals: Survive the outbreak in Kestrel Valley
Return anywhere on the globe from Act II
landmarks: The Bloom glyph drawn across the continents (visible from orbit)
levels.bloom: Rises with story progress (0% → 45% of the land surface)

planet.orbit: Haven-9 at 25 km altitude (above the 9 km atmosphere); the Moon's orbit at 360 km from Earth's centre
planet.notes: Gameplay scale, not astronomical scale: Earth keeps its continents and oceans, compressed into a 377 km circumference. Coastlines and continents come from a stylized cube-face heightmap so the Bloom glyph (M1.07) reads from orbit.

levels.name: The Moon
levels.summary: A 40 km airless voxel moon: grey regolith, craters, Earthrise, and the Tycho mining outpost. The first world the player lands a self-built ship on.
goals: Build a lander that can lift off in 0.16 g
landmarks: Earth in the sky (always visible from the near side)
levels.hazards: Vacuum, radiation during flares, Burrowers, dust storms (static-charged regolith)

planet.orbit: Lunar orbit at 8 km altitude; 360 km from Earth's centre
planet.notes: Tidally locked: Earth never moves in the near-side sky (a navigation landmark).

levels.name: Veyra-4
levels.summary: A 100 km jungle-and-ocean world with purple seas, continent-sized Bloom forests, Tessari herds and a 2 km Sower Garden Engine terraforming it in real time.
landmarks: The Garden Engine spire (2 km, visible from 16 km away)
levels.bloom: High (falls as the Engine is shut down)

planet.notes: Healing the planet (veyra_healed) repaints the Bloom map over the following in-game days.

levels.name: Hollowmere
levels.summary: An 80 km ice world at −80 °C: blizzards, ice caves and the Choir's Cathedral of the Hum over a Sower archive.

planet.notes: Blizzards cap visibility at 20 m, so navigation relies on the Cathedral's audio and the aurora.

levels.name: Drift Planet (procedural)
levels.summary: The template every procedural Drift planet is generated from: a seed picks size, type, gravity, atmosphere, biomes, Bloom coverage, ores and points of interest within the voxel-traversal scale.

planet.atmosphere: By type (none / thin / breathable / toxic / spore-laden)
biomes: 2–5 per planet from the type's pool (see game bible 08 §8.12)
planet.notes: Gravity is a gameplay value chosen by type, not derived from size. Planets under 40 km never get oceans (the sea would dominate the surface).

levels.name: Kestrel Valley
levels.summary: A 64 km² hand-authored open region of Nevada high desert ringed by mountains: the spaceport, its company town and nine other districts. The whole valley is open from the end of the prologue; danger (Bloom threat), not walls, gates the districts.
goals: Find survivors, parts and a base site
Complete the four Wren parts in any order
Explore districts for blueprints, caches and stories

spaces.name: Mountain rim
spaces.purpose: Impassable ring (visual boundary); flyable over from Act II

spaces.name: Route 93
spaces.purpose: North–south highway along x = −2 km, with spurs to the Township and Complex

encounters: Directorate drone patrols near crash sites
landmarks: Launch tower at Pad 39-K (110 m, visible from anywhere)

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Wind, insects by day, distant moans and coyotes by night; the Verdance clicks rise near Prospect.
levels.links: Leads to orbit via the Wren (M1.07); re-entry from Act II anywhere on Earth.
levels.build: Allowed (except within 150 m of story anchors)
levels.hazards: Heat waves, dust storms, flash floods, spore storms from Prospect
levels.notes: Authored flat in a local east-north-up frame and stamped onto Earth's cube-face heightmap (planet chapter 03): over 8 km the 60 km-radius surface drops about 133 m at the edges, which the stamp absorbs. Streams as 32 × 32 World Partition cells of 256 m. Districts are level instances placed at their map positions.

levels.name: Kestrel Aerospace Complex
levels.summary: The spaceport: hangars, Terminal B, launch pads, Mission Control, the fuel farm and the Vault beneath. The story hub of Act I.

spaces.name: Hangar row (Hangars 1–6)
spaces.purpose: Hangar 4 is the player's first base

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: PA systems looping evacuation messages, alarms fading over the first days, wind through hangar doors.
levels.build: Allowed at Hangar 4 and the aprons; no-build around Pad 39-K until M1.07

levels.name: Kestrel Township
levels.summary: The company town: diner, school, library, hardware store, gas station and suburbs. The first scavenging and rescue zone.
goals: Food, tools, first survivors (Lily, Danny, Rosa, the Webbs, Kenji)
encounters: Runner packs on Main Street at dusk
landmarks: Water tower with 'KESTREL' painted on it

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Wind chimes, a looping car alarm, dogs barking (Danny's strays).

levels.name: Route 93 & the Truck Stop
levels.summary: The highway: pile-ups, abandoned trailers and a fortified truck stop (Big Mo). Safest early loot; a roaming trader.
goals: Early loot, vehicles for parts, the roaming trader

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Wind across asphalt, a CB radio crackling.

levels.name: Jackrabbit Flats
levels.summary: A dry lake bed and old airstrip: flat, open, fast. The safest outpost site and the place to test rovers and aircraft.
encounters: Runner packs in the open at night

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Open wind, distant horses.

levels.name: Hollis Dam & Reservoir
levels.summary: A hydroelectric dam, lake and marina in the northern canyon. Restoring it gives enormous power, and enormous Attraction.
goals: Huge power if restored (a base-site choice)

spaces.name: Reservoir
spaces.purpose: Lake and marina behind the dam

encounters: Drowned Hollows in the marina (slow, water-logged)
Green Moon waves if the dam is powered
landmarks: The dam wall (visible from the Complex)

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Rushing water, turbine hum when restored.

levels.name: Silver Ridge Mines
levels.summary: Open-pit and shaft mines in the northeastern hills: iron, copper and silicon, with Burrowers in the deep shafts.

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Creaking timbers, dripping water, machinery ghosts.

levels.name: Red Mesa Observatory
levels.summary: A radio-telescope array on a 120 m mesa: early signal decoding, Styx lore and a sniper's-eye view of the valley.

spaces.name: Switchback road
spaces.purpose: Only vehicle access (800 m of hairpins folded into 700 m)

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: High wind, dish servos, radio static with the five-note pulse.

levels.name: Fort Calder
levels.summary: An abandoned military base overrun during the evacuation: weapons, armor, vehicles and blueprint fragments (the railgun). Very dangerous.
landmarks: Control tower with a red beacon

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Looping emergency broadcast, flags snapping.

levels.name: Prospect (City Edge)
levels.summary: The edge of a small city swallowed by a Bloom Heart cluster. The best loot on Earth and the worst danger; the source of spore storms.
goals: Destroy Bloom Hearts to push back the Bloom
landmarks: Burning skyline and a green spore haze

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: The Verdance clicks at full intensity; distant collapses.

levels.name: Ghost Towns
levels.summary: Three silver-rush ruins (a motel, a church, a main street) with survivor camps, side stories and hidden caches. One is here; the others sit at (−1.1, −1.6) and (3.3, 0.4) km.

spaces.name: Dusty Rest Motel
spaces.purpose: Camp; satellite site at (−1.1, −1.6) km in KVL-001, blocked out here for layout

spaces.name: St. Brigid's Church
spaces.purpose: Survivor camp in the nave; satellite site at (3.3, 0.4) km in KVL-001, blocked out here for layout

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Creaking signs, tumbleweeds, church bell in the wind.

levels.name: Mission Control 2068
levels.summary: Kestrel Mission Control three years before the outbreak. Warm monitors, cold coffee: the player operates the Persephone arm and Styx flinches.
setpieces: The flinch on the main screen
levels.audio: Mission chatter, countdown, the room erupting; five radio pulses at the cut.
levels.notes: Same room as the Mission Control Tower's control floor (KES-009), dressed three years earlier.

levels.name: Hangar 4
levels.summary: Where the game begins and the player's first base. A cavernous hangar with the Wren launch stack, a parts cage, an office mezzanine and huge orange doors.
goals: Defend it on the Long Night (M1.06)

mood.light: Work lights, then the player's own

levels.audio: Big reverb, humming lights, rain on the roof.

levels.name: Service Corridors
levels.summary: Dark service corridors behind the hangar row. Emergency strobes, a first Hollow (Dana Marsh) and Tug trapped under a parts rack.
goals: Learn stealth, melee and the infection meter
levels.audio: Alarms, dripping, the Verdance clicks for the first time.

levels.name: Terminal B
levels.summary: The evacuation collapses: a crowd, Hollows inside it, a skywalk falling and a fuel truck exploding. The player carries Tug to Pad 12.
goals: Get Tug to Pad 12 before the Seraph leaves

spaces.name: Drop-off lane
spaces.purpose: Fuel-truck explosion; exits onto the apron

levels.audio: PA in four languages, crowd walla, alarms; music drops at the fence.

levels.name: Pad 12
levels.summary: The fence standoff: two hundred people at the wire, troopers at the gate, the Seraph on the pad. Ada leaves.

spaces.name: Retreat road
spaces.purpose: Back to Hangar 4 (leaves the level at the south edge)

levels.audio: Radio only: Ada and Crane. Wind. The launch roar.

levels.name: Kestrel Elementary
levels.summary: A two-floor school with a vent network. Lily guides the player through the building from inside the vents; the gym holds a horde.
setpieces: Fire alarm and sprinklers split the horde
landmarks: Lily's spiral drawings mark the route
levels.audio: Near silence; Lily's binaural whisper; sprinklers bring release.

levels.name: Ark Transport Crash Site
levels.summary: A Directorate transport shot down by its own drones. Idris is the only survivor.
levels.audio: Fire crackle, drone hum.

levels.name: The Vault
levels.summary: The BSL-4 lab beneath the Complex: flooded sub-levels, dead scientists behind glass, the first Screamer and the first Bloom Heart.
levels.audio: Dripping, pumps failing, jazz playing on a lab radio (Mara's log).

levels.name: Mission Control Tower
levels.summary: The control tower: restore power at three outdoor substations (a grid puzzle), then climb to the control floor for the guidance computer and Ada's recording.

spaces.name: Control floor
spaces.purpose: The cold-open room, three years later

setpieces: Lights coming on floor by floor
landmarks: Tower visible from the whole Complex

levels.audio: Wind at the top, servers rebooting.

levels.name: Fuel Farm
levels.summary: Rows of LOX and methane tanks, pipe racks and a pump house. Guns are dangerous here; Bloaters are everywhere. Walt waits in the office.
setpieces: Chain explosion if the player fires carelessly

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Hissing boil-off, metal ticking in the heat.

levels.name: Township Warehouse
levels.summary: A logistics warehouse with the heat-shield tiles; the first rover (the Mule) is built here, and Runner packs hunt the open lot outside.

spaces.name: Lot
spaces.purpose: Runner ambush on the drive out

mood.time: 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time
mood.light: Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night

levels.audio: Forklift beeps, echoing racks.

levels.name: Crashed Ark Shuttle
levels.summary: A crashed Directorate shuttle guarded by drones, with cleanup crews burning survivors nearby. Source of the Wren's life-support module.
goals: Avoid or fight the cleanup crew
setpieces: Cleanup crew burning a camp (seen from cover)
levels.audio: Flamethrowers, drone hum, Directorate radio chatter.

levels.name: Pad 39-K
levels.summary: The Wren's launch pad: a 110 m tower, the 300 m fuel line back to the farm and a perimeter the player fortifies for the Long Night, then the launch.
goals: Defend the hangar and fuel line (M1.06)

spaces.name: Fuel line
spaces.purpose: Pad segment of the 300 m line to the fuel farm; must stay intact during the siege

encounters: Long Night: ~140 Hollows in 3 waves, 4 Brutes, 3 Screamers, 6 Bloaters
levels.audio: Engine test roar, horde bed, silence in orbit.

levels.name: Low Earth Orbit
levels.summary: The debris belt around the 120 km Earth: dead satellites, a wrecked station ring and Haven-9 at 25 km altitude. Earth fills half the sky.

mood.light: One hard sun, Earth-shine fill, no ambient in vacuum

levels.audio: Silence outside; suit and hull sounds only.
levels.gravity: 0 g (above 20 km: Earth's gravity well falls off)
levels.notes: Level origin is Earth's centre (Earth's surface at 60 km). Orbital space streams in 2 km cells. Earth's gravity at 25 km altitude is ~9% of surface gravity (falloff exponent 7).

levels.name: Haven-9 Station
levels.act: II (and the colony's home until Act III)
levels.summary: A derelict 12-module research station restored into the colony's first real home. Every module is player-restorable and player-extendable.
goals: Restore power, O₂, pressure and heat (M2.02)
encounters: Directorate boarding (only if the colony stays for The Taking)
setpieces: Restoring the lights module by module

mood.light: One hard sun, Earth-shine fill, no ambient in vacuum

levels.audio: Station hum that changes as systems come back; silence when power fails.
levels.gravity: 0 g (spin ring optional via Habitat Ring Bearing)
levels.notes: Every module is a 5 m-diameter pressurized cylinder from KIT-HAV, so the air/room graph matches the building system.

levels.name: Lunar Near Side
levels.summary: The playable 10 × 10 km region around Tycho on the 40 km Moon: crater rims, maria, dust storms and Earthrise. The rest of the Moon is procedural.

mood.light: Hard sun, black shadows, Earthshine fill

levels.audio: Suit-only sound; thumps through the ground before Burrowers.
levels.notes: Capped at 10 km (a quarter of the Moon's 40 km diameter): the 20 km-radius surface still drops ~625 m at the region's edges, so the stamp's curvature correction is large. Keep gameplay-critical geometry within 3 km of the centre.

levels.name: Tycho Outpost
levels.summary: A three-deck lunar mining outpost overrun by infected miners in EVA suits. Home of the He-3 core and the Styx telemetry archive.
goals: Recover the He-3 core (heavy: winch it)
setpieces: Winching the He-3 core onto the lander
levels.audio: Muffled low-G combat, creaking decks.

levels.name: Styx Wreck
levels.summary: The hollow Sower seed pod, 1,500 km beyond Earth: ribbed corridors that breathe, glyph puzzles, a three-way fight and the Jump Core at its heart.
setpieces: Ada face to face in zero-G
landmarks: Teal glyph light down the corridors
levels.audio: Slow breathing, choral hum, the five-note motif.

levels.name: Tortuga Drift
levels.summary: The Free Hauler ship-city inside a hollowed 6 km asteroid: docks, markets, contracts, bars and the Hauler council.
levels.audio: Market walla, clanging, bar music.

levels.name: The Dust Queen
levels.summary: Oye's lost ship: a Hauler freighter overgrown by Bloom, adrift in a debris field. Recover the black box.
goals: Learn how Oye lost his crew
levels.audio: Creaking hull, Hauler music box still playing.

levels.name: Veyra-4 Jungle Region
levels.summary: The playable region around the Garden Engine on the 100 km Veyra-4: violet jungle, purple sea coast, Tessari plains and Bloom forest.
levels.audio: Dense jungle bed, Tessari calls, the Engine's hum.

levels.name: The Garden Engine
levels.summary: The 2 km Sower spire terraforming Veyra-4: a vertical climb through grown chambers to the vision at its core.
goals: Shut it down or take the Key
landmarks: Glowing core visible up the shaft
levels.audio: Rising choral hum as you climb.

levels.name: Cathedral of the Hum
levels.summary: The Choir's candle-lit sanctuary over a Sower archive on Hollowmere. Social stealth among pilgrims, tea with Mother Sable, the archive below.
encounters: Choir Pilgrims and Wardens (hostile only if provoked)
levels.audio: Choir hum (diegetic), wind, ice cracking.

levels.name: Ark Meridian
levels.summary: The Directorate flagship-station over the gas giant Meridian. A heist in three phases: get aboard, reach the labs, get out.
goals: Free Lily and the Null carriers
levels.audio: Directorate PA, hum of perfection, alarms.
levels.map:

levels.name: Convergence Gate
levels.summary: A Sower gate megastructure: the fleet-battle arena where allies and the Directorate collide as Anthesis comes through.
levels.audio: Battle chatter, choral swell as the gate opens.

levels.name: Anthesis Approach
levels.summary: Ship combat against the Seedship's defensive organisms, then the breach. Anthesis is a 30 km living vessel; its petal-sails are a 1,000 km VFX.
goals: Breach the hull with a boarding craft

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: Low organ-like groans; the five-note motif in the ship's calls.
levels.notes: The point of no return is marked with a clear prompt before this level loads.

levels.name: The Living Halls
levels.summary: The breathing hub between the four Memory Gardens: root corridors, pulsing chambers, and four petal-gates that open one garden each.
landmarks: The Heart hall's central light column

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: Heartbeat bed that speeds up as gardens are completed.

levels.name: Memory Garden 1 — Veyra, Before
levels.summary: Veyra-4 before the gardening: Tessari herds in their millions. It heals or haunts the player depending on veyra_healed.

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: Tessari calls, wind

levels.name: Memory Garden 2 — The Drowned Choir
levels.summary: An ocean world whose whale-like people sang. The Sowers harvested them before they understood. The reason the Sowers stopped.

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: The Drowned Choir song (key musical motif).

levels.name: Memory Garden 3 — The First Garden
levels.summary: The Sowers' own homeworld and their final recordings: they left because some gardens held minds, and they were ashamed.
goals: Witness the Sower Echoes' last recording
landmarks: A tower of shell and filament

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: Choral breath, silence.

levels.name: Memory Garden 4 — Permian Earth
levels.summary: Earth 252 million years ago, during the Great Dying: a dying Pangaea under a burning sky, Bloom-covered gorgonopsids, and Lily hearing 'sorry'.
levels.audio: Rumbling ground, Bloom clicks, gorgonopsid roars.

levels.name: The Living Bridges
levels.summary: Root-bridges over a 300 m bioluminescent chasm: where Ada holds the breach, or fights her sibling in the Seraph exo-frame.
goals: Or duel Ada (loyal) and talk her down

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: 'Sunday' theme on kora breaking through the battle.

levels.name: The Loom Chamber
levels.summary: A tiered organic amphitheatre around the Loom. Crane fights here in armor, then as the Graft while the arena grows; later, the final choice is made here.
goals: Choose the Instruction and the Weaver

mood.light: Bioluminescence that pulses with the ship's 'breath'

levels.audio: Crane's quartet theme inverted; the Loom's chorus.

levels.name: Bonsai Mind-Space
levels.summary: Inside the Loom: a colossal bonsai whose branches are platforms. Each branch Crane cuts darkens a city on the Earth below.
goals: Protect the branches that hold cities
levels.audio: Snip of shears as a rhythm; distant cities humming.
levels.gravity: Dream gravity (0.6 g, no fall damage)

levels.name: The Last Sunday Dinner
levels.summary: The final scene, staged in the player's own home (station, ship or base): a long table, the survivors, bad jollof, an empty chair for the Weaver.

spaces.name: Dining space
spaces.purpose: Long Dining Table (parts bible COL-008) in the player's mess hall

levels.audio: 'Sunday' theme; laughter; cutlery.
levels.notes: Procedurally staged: finds the player's largest mess hall with a Long Dining Table; falls back to a hand-built dining room on the ship.

levels.name: Derelict Ship
levels.summary: A drifting or crashed wreck assembled from room modules (bridge, crew, cargo, engineering) around a spine. Variants: Hauler, Directorate, Kestrel, pre-2071 human.
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Crash Site
levels.summary: A debris field around a broken fuselage with a survivor chance.
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Survivor Camp

levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

goals: Rewards: Bloom samples, Resonance Crystals; lowers local Bloom
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Sower Ruin
levels.summary: Grown chambers with a glyph puzzle and a precursor cache.
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Directorate Outpost
levels.summary: A white-gold prefab base with turrets, drones and a comms tower.
goals: Rewards: High-tech loot, intel, blueprint fragments
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Choir Shrine
levels.summary: Candles, moss and a listening stone; pilgrims tend it.
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Hauler Waystation
levels.summary: A container-built rest stop with a landing pad, a bar and a repair bay.
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Anomaly
levels.summary: Hand-authored one-off events dropped into procedural space: a lone construct, a time-dilated signal, a pre-2071 human ship.
goals: Rewards: Unique one-off rewards and lore
levels.build: Restricted (no-build inside the footprint until cleared)

levels.name: Wonders
levels.summary: Rare procedural phenomena discovered once per save: the Singing Ring, the Glass Forest, the Tidal Titan, the Frozen Fleet and the Mirror World.

spaces.name: The Singing Ring
spaces.purpose: Planetary ring that hums the Verdance motif when flown through

spaces.name: Glass Forest
spaces.purpose: Silicate trees that ring like bells

spaces.name: Tidal Titan
spaces.purpose: Sleeping mountain-sized creature in a shallow sea

spaces.name: Frozen Fleet
spaces.purpose: Sower Seedlings locked in a comet

spaces.name: The Mirror World
spaces.purpose: Ruins matching a human city layout

levels.name: Earth Returns Region
levels.summary: The template for procedural Earth regions outside Kestrel Valley on the 120 km Earth: city ruins, forests, coasts and tundra, with Bloom density rising as the story advances.

levels.name: Player Base Zones
levels.summary: Rules for where and how players build: base sites on every planet, no-build volumes, Attraction and horde approach lanes, and how authored spaces accept player blocks.
goals: At least 6 good base sites per open region
encounters: Horde nights sized by Attraction (game bible 22 §22.5)
